title: Shift-loop instruction
statement: For a natural number $E$, a register $r$ among $18$ registers, an exit label $e$, a function $m$ assigning a label to each of nine phases, and a phase $j\in\{0,1,\ldots,8\}$, define the instruction by these cases: at phase $0$, branch on whether the loop counter $c$ is zero, going to $e$ if so and to $m(1)$ otherwise; at phase $1$, decrement $c$ and go to $m(2)$; at phase $2$, branch on whether $r=0$, going to $m(6)$ if so and to $m(3)$ otherwise; at phase $3$, decrement $r$ and go to $m(4)$; at phase $4$, increment the scratch register $z$ and go to $m(5)$; at phase $5$, increment $z$ and go to $m(2)$; at phase $6$, branch on whether $z=0$, going to $m(0)$ if so and to $m(7)$ otherwise; at phase $7$, decrement $z$ and go to $m(8)$; at phase $8$, increment $r$ and go to $m(6)$.
